title: Cebuano short film ‘Gasolina’ bags four FAMAS nominations
summary: LILOAN, Cebu – Cebuano content creator Joseph “Ungart” Sabello’s ‘Gasolina: A Holy Week Special Film’ has received four nominations at the 2026 Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (FAMAS)…

blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Cebuano content creator Joseph “Ungart” Sabello’s ‘Gasolina: A Holy Week Special Film’ has received four nominations at the 2026 Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (FAMAS) Awards. Sabello announced the nominations in a social media post, celebrating the film’s recognition in four categories: Best Screenplay, Best Actor for Boy Isog Sarge, Best Regional Film, and Best Picture. In his announcement, a netizen proudly left a remark saying, “Wow!! The Metaphor for Fatherhood, the film portrays the children as the literal “gasoline” or fuel.
